text.title: Google Analytics 4 Setup Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the GA4 property config: the numeric property id and each stream's G- measurement id as separate fields, every enhanced measurement toggle with one page_view source on single-page apps, custom dimensions registered with scope and counted against the plan limits, key events declared by exact event name with a counting method, the purchase event with transaction_id / value / currency / items, Consent Mode v2 defaults before the config call, the BigQuery export linked before launch with 14-month retention and the sampling guard, Measurement Protocol reusing the browser client_id with the api_secret server-side, and the internal-traffic filter, unwanted referrals covering every checkout and auth domain, and the cross-domain list. Validator at scripts/validate-google-analytics.py enforces it, including the slot counts, the key-event name match and the referral coverage.

required.field: numeric `property_id`; each stream with its own `G-` `measurement_id`, `type`, `spa`, `manual_page_view`, `send_page_view` (r-property-id-and-measurement-id-distinct, r-enhanced-measurement-declared-no-double-page-view)

the state of every toggle: page_views, history_change_page_view, scrolls, outbound_clicks, site_search, video_engagement, file_downloads, form_interactions (r-enhanced-measurement-declared-no-double-page-view)
`limits` for the plan, `registered[]` with `parameter`, `scope` and `kind`, and `used` counts that match and stay within the limits (r-custom-dimensions-registered-within-limits)
the property's event list and at most 30 key events, each an exact `event_name` from that list with `counting` once_per_event or once_per_session (r-key-events-declared-by-exact-name)
when enabled: `required_parameters` transaction_id, value, currency, items; `transaction_id_source: order_id`; `stable_across_retries: true` (r-purchase-transaction-id-dedup)
when in scope: `implementation` basic or advanced, `defaults_before_config: true`, the four signals, `regions[]`, `update_on_choice: true` (r-consent-mode-v2-defaults-before-config)
`internal` with `ip_rules` and `state: active`, `checkout_and_auth_domains[]` every one of which appears in `unwanted_referrals[]`, `cross_domain[]` (r-internal-traffic-referral-and-cross-domain)

forbidden.pattern: a `used` count that does not match `registered[]`, or above the plan limit — unregistered-custom-parameters
a SPA stream with `manual_page_view: true` while `enhanced_measurement.history_change_page_view` is true, or with `send_page_view: true` — double-page-view-on-spa
a checkout or auth domain missing from `unwanted_referrals`, or `traffic_filters.internal.state: testing` — payment-provider-self-referral
`consent.defaults_before_config: false` or a missing v2 signal while consent is in scope — consent-default-after-config
`measurement_protocol.fresh_client_id: true`, `api_secret_storage` other than server_only, or `session_id_included: false` — server-events-with-fresh-client-id
a `property_id` with a `G-` prefix, or a `measurement_id` that is numeric — r-property-id-and-measurement-id-distinct
a key event whose `event_name` is not in `events[]` (case included), or a purchase without `items` — r-key-events-declared-by-exact-name, r-purchase-transaction-id-dedup

list.item: `property_id` is numeric and every stream has a `G-` `measurement_id`; the snippet and Measurement Protocol use the latter, the APIs and BigQuery the former (r-property-id-and-measurement-id-distinct).

All eight enhanced measurement toggles are declared; a SPA stream either uses `history_change_page_view` or sends `page_view` manually with `send_page_view: false`, never both (r-enhanced-measurement-declared-no-double-page-view).
Every reported parameter is in `registered[]` with its scope, registered before the first send, and `used` matches the list and stays under `limits` (r-custom-dimensions-registered-within-limits).
Every key event is an exact name from `events[]` with a counting method; at most 30 (r-key-events-declared-by-exact-name).
`purchase` requires transaction_id, value, currency and items, with the order id as `transaction_id` stable across retries (r-purchase-transaction-id-dedup).
Consent defaults with the four v2 signals precede the config call, regions are listed, updates fire on choice, and the implementation is recorded (r-consent-mode-v2-defaults-before-config).
BigQuery daily export is linked before launch with its location, retention is 14 months, and decision reports over the sampling threshold come from BigQuery (r-bigquery-export-linked-before-launch).
Measurement Protocol reuses the `_ga` client_id with session_id and engagement_time_msec, and the api_secret never reaches the browser (r-measurement-protocol-reuses-client-id).
The internal filter is active with IP rules, every checkout and auth domain is an unwanted referral, and the cross-domain list covers the journey (r-internal-traffic-referral-and-cross-domain).

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the slot-count, key-event and referral checks.
